## ClusterManager.remove() method

Unregisters a cluster from this manager.

**Signature:**

```typescript
remove(cluster: string | InitializedCluster, destroy?: boolean): Promise<void>;
```

## Remarks

Unregistering the last cluster destroys the manager and releases its transport — for [UDPClusterManager](/api/core/latest/core.udpclustermanager/) that means shutting down the shared broadcast worker. Calling this with an unknown id while no clusters remain also triggers that shutdown, which is why `destroy()` implementations must be idempotent.
